title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

reports.title: Data Center Is Fined $1.1 Million for Operating 62 Power Generators

summary:
New Jersey regulators fined DataOne $1.07 million for running 62 large natural gas generators without required permits at its Vineland data center site. Inspectors found the tractor trailer size, 2,000 kilowatt units in late July. The fine is the largest ever issued to a data center operator in the state under the Air Pollution Control Act. The campus, planned for completion by the end of this year, will cover 2.6 million square feet and need 350 megawatts of power, enough for a medium size city, and part of it is already operating.

The project has drawn complaints over noise, and a group of homeowners has filed a federal lawsuit against DataOne. The Cumberland County Health Department has also issued violation orders for excessive noise. Governor Mikie Sherrill said such development must benefit New Jersey communities. The article does not say what DataOne will do next.
